content.comment_body: Hello, I have a new [product_name] device connected to my PC through a router, but I can't upload any programs. The device uses IP 192.168.1.103 / 255.255.255.0 / gateway 223.000.000.000, and the PC uses 192.168.1.101 / 255.255.255.0. The PC can detect the device as accessible, but clicking on it does not load the program. I've used several devices with this setup before without issue. Any advice?

Which [product_name] version are you using? Is it [article_no].Standard or [product_name] FS04? Also, which [product_name] software version do you have—[version_no] or [version_no]? Why is your gateway address set to 223.000.000.000? The gateway should be the router's address.
Hi, I'm using [product_name] [article_no] with software version [version_no]. The gateway is now set to 192.168.1.254.
First, try connecting the [product_name] directly to your PC, without using the router. Does your PC have a static IP address?

Hi, I switched to a laptop and connected it directly. Laptop IP is 192.168.1.101 / 255.255.255.0 / 192.168.1.254, and the [product_name] device is still at 192.168.1.103 / 255.255.255.0 / 192.168.1.254. The laptop does not have a static IP. The result is the same—now I get a password prompt, I enter "[product_name]" and can connect, but still can't upload a program. The device is powered by a 12V DC 500mA supply.
That's not the same issue. [user_name] mentioned using an [article_no].Standard, not FS04 like you.
In the lower right corner of your diagram, look for a button with an "i" symbol. When an event occurs, this "i" icon will animate. Click on it and capture a screenshot of any messages displayed.
Hi, I've attached a screen image of the device and software interface for reference. The [product_name] software I have is from RS, version [version_no], but it won't update to [version_no].

Hi [user_name], I believe you have a [product_name] [article_no] FS04 model. Consult the following: [document] and [document]. If you can't upload programs to your [product_name], you need to update your software to [version_no]. Download the appropriate version, including any necessary demo software, upgrades/updates, and drivers, and install it. Best regards, [user_name]

Actually, your device is a [product_name] [article_no].FS04, not [article_no].Standard. This was my initial question—whether it's [article_no].Standard or [article_no].FS04. For the FS04 version, you need the software version [version_no]. You cannot upload programs to FS04 with software [version_no], since FS04 isn't selectable until [version_no]. So [user_name]'s advice was correct.
Hello all, thanks for your assistance—this resolved my issue!

analysis.insight_summary: The user encountered problems uploading programs to the [product_name] device even though network connectivity appeared correct and the device was detected by the PC. Troubleshooting included changing network hardware and direct connections, which did not solve the issue. The software interface requested a password but failed to allow programming access. Ultimately, the problem persisted because the software version was incompatible with the device version.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects successful program upload to the [product_name] device after establishing a working network connection and device recognition by compatible software.
